authority.mandatory_stop: Stop after Step 5A is documented and sealed. A later explicit instruction is required before acquisition or research-value access.
authority.reference_book_role: Primary business vocabulary, point-in-time, market-logic, epistemic, and explanation specification; not a predetermined empirical answer.

research_question: At the separately defined London and New York decision cutoffs, do preregistered GC order-flow and top-ten book states, alone or in a bounded two-condition interaction with point-in-time fundamental bias and price/session context, change the subsequent neutral XAUUSD session direction frequency in a stable and explainable way?

locked_independent_and_prospective.unlock_requires: A later candidate-specific sealed protocol and explicit user authorization

outcome_blind_development_sample.monthly_rule: For each calendar month, enumerate Mondays whose Monday-through-Friday block lies wholly within that month, sort ascending, and select the second such block.
outcome_blind_development_sample.selected_trade_dates: All five Monday-through-Friday calendar dates in the selected block, then remove permanent engineering exclusions without replacement.
outcome_blind_development_sample.holiday_policy: Do not replace a holiday, early close, missing date, or incomplete prediction window. Record it as unavailable under the frozen missing-data policy.
outcome_blind_development_sample.request_grouping: Combine only consecutive selected UTC calendar dates belonging to the same selected sample week; never bridge an excluded or unselected date.

session_contract.separation: London and New York are independent research units; pooled statistics are descriptive only.

LONDON.utc_conversion: Use Python IANA zoneinfo at the local session date. This is normally 08:00Z in GMT and 07:00Z in BST; no hard-coded DST dates.

NEW_YORK.utc_conversion: Use Python IANA zoneinfo at the local session date. This is normally 13:00Z in EST and 12:00Z in EDT; no hard-coded DST dates.

session_contract.dst_mismatch_weeks: Each session is converted independently. US/UK transition-date mismatch is expected and is not repaired.
session_contract.decision_availability_gate: Every feature source record must have available_at <= decision_cutoff; equality is allowed only for a record fully published by that instant.

cme_market_state_schedule.continuous_matching: 17:00 previous local date through 16:00 current local date
cme_market_state_schedule.special_schedule_policy: An exchange holiday or special schedule must be verified from metadata before feature construction; unresolved status makes the affected feature window UNKNOWN.

neutral_session_outcomes.reference: The open of the first complete one-minute XAUUSD bar with local open timestamp exactly 08:01:00 and available_at no earlier than its close.
neutral_session_outcomes.observation_interval: From the 08:01 local reference through the final complete one-minute bar whose close timestamp is no later than 12:00 local.

primary_outcome.signed_displacement: final_close minus reference_open in USD per troy ounce

states.UNKNOWN: reference or final bar missing/incomplete, timestamp rule fails, or lineage is invalid

primary_outcome.binary_discovery_policy: UP and DOWN only; retain and report FLAT but exclude it from binary direction inference. Never relabel FLAT after results.

secondary_descriptive_outcomes: signed displacement at fixed 5, 15, 30, and 60 elapsed-minute horizons
maximum upward excursion from the neutral reference
maximum downward excursion from the neutral reference
dominant excursion direction and absolute magnitude
time in elapsed minutes to first maximum upward and downward excursion
completed interactions with frozen Asia and prior-day levels
first directional move and whether it held or reversed by session close
neutral_session_outcomes.secondary_outcome_role: DESCRIPTIVE_AND_CONSISTENCY_ONLY; never select, rank, rescue, or reject a candidate in this contract version

eligible_decision_state.fundamental_bias_contexts: Exactly the eight entries in the frozen Step 5A feature-hypothesis registry.
eligible_decision_state.price_level_and_session_contexts: Exactly the seven entries in the frozen Step 5A feature-hypothesis registry.
eligible_decision_state.microstructure_columns: Exactly all 85 sealed Step 4A columns, each assigned exactly one governance, quality, derivation, or registered-transform role.
eligible_decision_state.microstructure_derived_states: Exactly the eight state definitions and only the W60/W900 windows in the frozen Step 5A feature-hypothesis registry.
eligible_decision_state.unknown_policy: UNKNOWN is never zero, flat, normal, no-event, balanced, confirmation, or safety. Exclude pairwise from a test and report missingness.
eligible_decision_state.institutional_claim_policy: Anonymous order flow and COT interpretations may be INFERRED; they never identify an institution or prove motive.

hypothesis_search_space.stage_1: Test each registered standalone directional microstructure state once per session. Fundamental, level, liquidity-condition, calendar-risk, and COT contexts have no standalone directional pass gate.
hypothesis_search_space.stage_2: Test only the explicitly listed two-condition interactions once per eligible session and only after the complete Stage-1 result table is sealed.

support_gates.dependence_cluster: selected_month_week_id; the five dates in one selected week are one resampling/permutation cluster
support_gates.flat_rows: Retained in descriptive totals but do not satisfy UP-or-DOWN support.
support_gates.duplicate_rows: Duplicate session_code plus session_date is an integrity failure, not extra support.
support_gates.support_failure: Record SUPPORT_FAIL and calculate descriptive counts only; it cannot advance.

uncertainty_and_multiplicity.effect: Pr(frozen favorable direction | condition) minus Pr(frozen favorable direction | known complement), in percentage points.
uncertainty_and_multiplicity.complement: All rows in the same session for which every constituent is known and the exact registered condition is false; never only the opposite state unless the registry explicitly makes the variable binary.

confidence_interval.method: calendar-year-stratified selected-week cluster bootstrap percentile interval
confidence_interval.seed: unsigned first 64 bits of SHA-256('GC_MICRO_STEP5_V1|' + session + '|' + test_id + '|BOOTSTRAP')

p_value.method: two-sided calendar-year-stratified selected-week block-label permutation test
p_value.seed: unsigned first 64 bits of SHA-256('GC_MICRO_STEP5_V1|' + session + '|' + test_id + '|PERMUTATION')

multiple_testing.families: Separate complete families by session and stage: LONDON_STAGE_1, NEW_YORK_STAGE_1, LONDON_STAGE_2, NEW_YORK_STAGE_2.
multiple_testing.included_tests: Every support-eligible preregistered test, including negative and contrary-sign results; unsupported tests are reported but receive no p or q value.

calendar_stability.rolling_window: Twelve consecutive selected monthly weeks, advanced one selected month at a time

ranking_order: highest lower 95 percent cluster confidence bound

source_request_contract.request_span: Full selected UTC calendar dates, grouped only as allowed by the frozen sample registry.

step_5a_readiness_rules.research_ready_at_step_5a: Only if design and metadata coverage gates pass; actual prediction-window completeness remains conditional until a separately authorized acquisition and value-blind source-integrity audit.

prohibited: acquiring, submitting, downloading, or incurring a charge
opening GC MBO or MBP-10 market values
calculating relationships, effect estimates, p-values, candidates, signals, trades, PnL, R multiples, or account returns
adding a feature, window, transform, state, interaction, threshold, support gate, multiplicity method, or ranking rule after outcome access
trade construction, entry/exit logic, stop/target logic, sizing, slippage modeling, or execution optimization
opaque machine learning, automated feature selection, and unregistered data mining
treating inferred institutional activity as observed fact
granting research or validation credit to any engineering-only date
using 2025 to design or retune and inspecting any 2026 value
completion_policy: Step 5A ends after the contract, feature-hypothesis registry, sample/request registry, coverage audit, two independently reproduced metadata quotes, report, verdict, and manifest are sealed.
